questions.q: What are the hosts in 'the Lord of hosts'?
choices: The armies of angels that stand before Him
questions.explain: Jacob called the place Mahanaim, two hosts or camps (2 Esdras 8:21).

questions.q: How did Jacob pray when he heard Esau was coming with four hundred men?
choices: Humbly, pleading the covenant made to his fathers
questions.explain: That is the pattern for our prayers: plead the promise made to the fathers.

questions.q: Why did Jacob send droves ahead as a present?
choices: A man's gift maketh room for him: to appease Esau before they met

questions.q: What does the name Israel mean?
choices: A prince that has power with God
questions.explain: As a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

questions.q: Who did Jacob wrestle with at Peniel?
questions.explain: He had power over the angel, and prevailed (Hosea 12:3-4).
